meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启用超工作模式的相关设置。

howto.what: 触发后，Claude 会在回复首行显示 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`，并按该模式的规则执行：先明确目标与验收标准，边做边记工作笔记，按计划推进并优先写测试，最后给出能证明改动生效的真实结果。
howto.when: 当你的消息中出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式：修复登录接口报 500 的错误
say.note: 回复会先显示开启声明，再按此目标执行。

say.text: ulw，给 utils.ts 里的函数补上单元测试
say.note: 会先要求失败的测试，再实现并跑通。

say.text: ultrawork，实现 CSV 导出并验证边界情况
say.note: 会列出验证场景，并展示实际运行结果。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude's reply begins with 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!' and it follows a strict coding workflow: define the goal and success criteria, maintain a notepad, use test-first, and deliver real verification results.
howto.when_en: Activates when your message contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode: fix the login endpoint that returns 500.
say_en.note: Shows the enable line, then works on that goal.

say_en.text: ulw, add unit tests for the functions in utils.ts.
say_en.note: Failing test first, then implement to green.

say_en.text: ultrawork, implement CSV export and verify edge cases.
say_en.note: Names verification scenarios and shows real run results.
